scenes.script: Sourav says: Ami jokhon-e English bolte jetam, freeze hoye jetam. Mistake korar ekdom bhoy chilo mathay.
scenes.on_screen_text: English bolte bhoy lagchhe? Mistake korar tension?

scenes.script:
Sourav says: Tarpor ami khunje pelam Supernova AI. Amar AI teacher, Miss Nova, amar level analyze kore ekta personalized plan baniye dey.
Sourav says: Aar ami private-e practice korte pari. Keu dekhar nei, aar uni amar mistake niye judge koren na.
scenes.on_screen_text: Supernova AI-er sathe meet koro! Tomar personal AI teacher-er sathe jekono somoy practice koro.

scenes.script: Sourav says: Ekhon aar shudhu textbook porte hoy na. Ami actually loud-e kotha boli, Miss Nova aar Moumita-r moto baki learner-der sathe practice kori.
scenes.on_screen_text: Loud-e kotha bolo aar ekta supportive community-r sathe practice koro!

scenes.script:
Sourav says: Amra real-life situations practice kori, jemon Kolkata-te amar upcoming job-interview.
Sourav says: Daily practice kore amar confidence-e ekta bhalo change dekhte pachhi.
scenes.on_screen_text: Job-interview-r moto real-life scenarios practice koro. Aajke-i suru koro!

scenes.script: Sourav says: Ghonta-r por ghonta scroll kore somoy nosto koro na. Supernova AI-ke dine 15 minutes dao. App-ta download koro aar bolte suru koro!
scenes.on_screen_text: Dine shudhu 15 minutes. Aaj-i Supernova AI download koro!
